q: Which molecule has a triple bond?
How many covalent bonds are in a water molecule?
Explain how two chlorine atoms form a covalent bond.
Each atom shares one electron, so both get a full outer shell of 8; the shared pair holds them together.
Nitrogen has a very strong triple bond but boils at -196 °C. Explain why.
Boiling separates molecules, not atoms: it only overcomes the weak forces between molecules. The covalent bond inside N₂ is not broken.
